## Load libraries

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2) 
```

## Load data

```{r}
wta <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gruggeri/tennis_wta/master/wta_grand_slam_data.csv")

# keep only the finals to get the tournament winners

finals <- wta %>% 
  filter(round == "F")

# calculate total wins by player

total_wins <- finals %>% 
  group_by(winner_name) %>% 
  summarise(total_wins = n()) %>% 
  arrange(-total_wins) %>% 
  ungroup()

```

## Exercise

Try now to create a bar plot to show the number of total wins by player.
The `geom` you need to use is `geom_col()`.

```{r eval= FALSE}

ggplot(data = total_wins, 
       mapping = aes(x = total_wins,
                     y = winner_name)) +
  geom_col()
```
